requiredClient: reviewed private libpq17 client or separately qualified equivalent

execution.connectionInput: approved private handoff; never command line, environment autodiscovery, receipt, or URL option
execution.sourceBytes: checked-in exact bundle only; no caller SQL or caller-selected module
execution.window: exact executor/client/target/source/approval-bound start and end; independently verified before connection and each dependent submission
execution.windowOverrun: stop forward work; rollback recovery and independent verification remain mandatory under explicitly approved recovery scope

authority.verification: trusted authority implementation must authenticate issuer, audience, approved executor/client, exact target/source/bundle/manifest, scope, freshness, revocation, and exact execution window before any dependent live action
authority.privateBaseline: server-side exact source/unrelated-row comparison; no stored credential or secret-derived digest returned
authority.membership: only absent postgres-grantor owner membership: ADMIN false, INHERIT false, SET true; preserve all original grantors/options
authority.columnPrivilege: only missing UPDATE(connection_string) granted by owner; existing SELECT required; no new SELECT
authority.cleanup: remove only introduced grants using original grantors/options; exact raw relation and all-column ACL comparison including NULL versus empty array; refuse unsupported baseline

acknowledgments.completion: send accepted is not completion; require one exact command result, expected command tag/result shape, all results consumed, and matching transaction state before next command
acknowledgments.begin: BEGIN submission starts uncertainty tracking even if its acknowledgment is lost
acknowledgments.operation: one unchanged guarded DO completion with expected DO command tag and no result rows; the DO's internal ROW_COUNT guard proves update one on completion (do not pretend DO emits a rowCount=1 result). Separately pinned private postcondition phase requires selected once, credential equality, exact target/three parameters and all unrelated rows stable; unchanged DO's probe guard establishes distinct auditor/TLS only under genuine external CA/logging bindings
acknowledgments.deadlines: separate completed SET LOCAL commands 7000ms and 500ms; observe effective values before the unchanged DO
acknowledgments.rollback: exact ROLLBACK command completion and transaction idle; never infer success from socket close or watchdog
acknowledgments.cancel: libpq17 encrypted PQcancelCreate/PQcancelStart/PQcancelPoll transport completion is not proof the original command canceled; connect_timeout is ignored during Poll so client observation deadline is mandatory; consume original results to terminal completion before recovery; deprecated plaintext PQcancel/PQgetCancel forbidden
acknowledgments.drain: PQconsumeInput/PQisBusy/PQgetResult to final null, freeing each result; no new command while the previous command is outstanding
acknowledgments.timeouts: bounded observation budgets trigger cancellation/recovery; event loop, transport, and server scheduling may exceed nominal limits; no strict wall deadline promise

recovery.errorOrAbortedTransaction: skip success cleanup; explicit ROLLBACK once primary protocol is drained; independent verifier required
recovery.unknownOutstandingCommand: cancel and drain; if unconfirmed, do not enqueue ROLLBACK behind uncertain work; use approved connection termination/recovery and independent verifier
recovery.disconnect: UNKNOWN; independent read-only verifier on distinct connection required regardless of primary connectivity
recovery.lostRollbackAcknowledgment: UNKNOWN even when independent baseline comparison matches; no automatic retry or replay
recovery.independentVerifier: distinct authenticated read-only postgres session with matching approved nonlocal schema/role/logging/CA context; compareSecurity(restored) excludes only verifier-local deadlines. Primary same-session compareSecurity(rollback) after acknowledged rollback separately establishes original primary settings; independent PID/backend_start checks establish original transaction/operation-lock completion. Unavailable, mismatched, or failed checks stay UNKNOWN
recovery.baseline: exact data/all ACLs/all membership grantors and options/role flags/owner/RLS/policy/settings restoration; previous legitimate UPDATE retained when initially present
recovery.generalReceipt: allowlisted public identifiers, public source hashes, counts/booleans, timestamps, configured and separately measured times, fixed refusal codes, rollback acknowledgment, independent verification; suppress raw errors, URI, credential, secret-derived hash, sensitive logs
